title: Cooling tower circulating-water loop
goal: A utility engineer can trace circulation, basin makeup and blowdown, and the cold-water temperature loop.

rubric.must: The basin, circulating pumps, process cooler, and cooling tower form a visible circulating-water path.
LT-601 and LIC-601 visibly connect to LV-601, which is visibly piped from MakeupWater to the basin.
AT-601 and AIC-601 visibly connect to AV-601 on the basin blowdown line.
TT-601, TIC-601, and TV-601 form a readable temperature-control loop.
LV-601 and AV-601 visibly show FC, while TV-601 visibly shows FO.
P-601A and P-601B are visibly labelled as circulating and standby pumps.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG visibly satisfies both blockers and the specified control-loop, fail-position, and pump-label requirements, while the picture omits required equipment and uses different tags.
